property.description: Price mode the resolved price is expressed in, either GROSS_MODE or NET_MODE.

property.description: Resolved price formatted with the currency symbol, the same way the storefront money filter formats it.

property.description: Price before the discount, present only when it is higher than the resolved price.

property.description: Original price formatted with the currency symbol, rendered struck through next to the resolved price.

property.description: First concrete product of the abstract, the one its price is resolved for. Internal, never forwarded to the AI provider.

property.description: SKU of the first concrete product, used to resolve its default product offer. Internal, never forwarded to the AI provider.

property.description: Specification attributes of the abstract product from storage, keyed by attribute key, so the agent compares and filters products by their real data.

property.description: Values each variant-defining attribute takes across the concrete products, keyed by attribute key. Present only when the product has several variants.

property.name: variantCount
property.description: Number of concrete products of the abstract. Present only when it is more than one.

property.name: rating
property.description: Average customer rating as indexed by the catalog search. Present only for rated products.

property.description: Number of customer reviews behind the rating. Present only for rated products.

property.description: Localized names of the product labels the product carries, such as SALE or New.

property.description: Short reason the product card is suggested, at most 60 characters, rendered under the product name.

property.description: True when the price is more than the configured factor times the median price of the other same-name products shown with it. Present only when true.
